status: registered before any v6 episode is scored; freeze6.json holds the digests of this file and run6.py before the v6 run
motivation_from_v5b: The v5b measurement (log/20260928/VIABILITY_CONTRAST_V5B.md) established four facts this protocol responds to. (1) On the 39-class task-policy pair, margin-statistic qualification is impossible even under perfect label-blind response prediction (oracle_reading: 0.77-0.87 wrong at tau 34): the margin over 39 x 443 choices is pure optimizer's-curse surface. (2) The learned completion channel is retired AT THE DECISION LEVEL ON THAT TASK-POLICY PAIR (off_mi beat holdout_mi in 4/5 folds despite w = 1 selected by training LL); the retirement is registered as task-policy-specific, not universal. (3) UCB-grade certification of a 5 percent wrong rate needs >= 59 zero-wrong decisions, so any future certified decision needs either much more calibration data or sequential methods with stated assumptions. (4) The registered next direction (v5 section 3.6, carried by v5b section 7) is a reformulation: a statistic the acquisition cannot game, or the native two-compound contrast. This protocol unifies both: in a TWO-HYPOTHESIS contrast the log-likelihood ratio IS an e-process, which is game-proof by construction under its stated assumptions.

task.episode: One held-out compound X with true class h* (from the frozen pack, folds and labels unchanged) and ONE rival class h_r. The decision is binary: h* vs h_r, or abstain. The episode menu, budget 16, QC-charge rule (a purchased line without a reading consumes budget, no update) and pool are inherited unchanged from the frozen pack (protocol.json).
task.rival_selection: h_r is the class whose training-fold template is NEAREST to h* over the pool lines: mean over pool lines of |med(h*,j) - med(h_r,j)| / max((s(h*,j)+s(h_r,j))/2, 0.05), using only (class, line) cells valid for both classes; ties broken by SHA256(KEY|h*|class_name). Computed from training folds only, deterministic, registered before any episode score. The nearest rival is the hardest registered contrast; an episode whose h* has fewer than 20 jointly valid pool cells with its rival is skipped and counted as such.
task.hypothesis_space_note: With two hypotheses the belief is a scalar (the LLR). There is no 39-way optimizer's-curse surface: the decision statistic is one-dimensional and its null behaviour is distribution-tractable.

statistic_e_process.definition: LLR_t = sum over purchased lines j with a reading a_j of [ log p(a_j | h*, history) - log p(a_j | h_r, history) ]. Decide h* when LLR >= +L, decide h_r when LLR <= -L, abstain at budget exhaustion. L = log(1/alpha), alpha = 0.05, L = 2.9957, FIXED A PRIORI. There is no tau and no calibration.
statistic_e_process.variant_stat_marginal: p(a_j | h, history) = the class template Gaussian N(med(h,j), s(h,j)^2) (pooled fallback where the class cell is invalid), winsorized at |z| <= 3 exactly as qualify2.term_matrix. Conditionals are treated as independent across lines (naive).
statistic_e_process.variant_stat_world: p(a_j | h, history) = the blended predictive of world5b.LearnedWorld at line j under hypothesis h GIVEN the episode's purchased readings (holdout blend, per-fold rank and weight selected by the frozen world5b machinery on training compounds only). The world posterior over latents is updated from raw readings (hypothesis-free); the per-hypothesis predictive then fuses the class template with the completion. This addresses within-compound correlation across lines approximately.
statistic_e_process.validity_theory: If the per-step predictive equalled the true conditional law of the next reading under h_r, exp(LLR_t) would be a nonnegative martingale under h_r for ANY predictable acquisition rule (each purchased line may be chosen using the full purchase history), and Ville's inequality would give P(ever LLR >= L | h_r true) <= alpha = 0.05 without any calibration: the acquisition cannot game the statistic by construction. References (verified by retrieval 2026-10-08): Ville (1939); Wald (1945) SPRT; Ramdas, Grunwald, Vovk, Shafer (2023) 'Game-theoretic statistics and safe anytime-valid inference', Statistical Science 38(4):576-601; Howard, Ramdas, McAuliffe, Sekhon (2021) Probability Surveys 18:257-317; Shafer and Vovk (2019); conditional e-process complete-class results (Clerico, arXiv:2606.06769).
registered_limitations: Neither variant's predictive IS the true conditional law: stat_marginal ignores within-compound correlation; stat_world approximates it through a learned completion whose decision-level value failed on the 39-class task. Exact martingale validity is therefore NOT claimed. Empirical Type-I behaviour is MEASURED on held-out episodes and label-breaking shuffled controls and reported with Clopper-Pearson one-sided 95 percent UCBs (v5b C4 discipline).
Winsorization at |z| <= 3 (stat_marginal) breaks the exact martingale; a no-winsorization sensitivity arm is reported.

The world posterior update conditions on readings as if per-line Gaussian with the fitted basis; the basis-leakage approximation of protocol5 carries over to rank/weight selection (training compounds only; held-out compounds never contribute).
Deciding h_r at -L is symmetric: the same e-process argument bounds P(decide h_r | h* true) <= alpha under the true conditionals.

acquisition_rules.note: All rules are predictable given the purchase history, so none of them can invalidate the e-process under its stated assumptions; they differ only in POWER (coverage and measurements per decision).
acquisition_rules.acq_fixed: Deterministic pair-separation order: pool lines ranked by |med(h*,j)-med(h_r,j)| / max((s(h*,j)+s(h_r,j))/2, 0.05) from training-fold templates, SHA tie-break; the v2 fixed_informative analogue restricted to the contrast pair.
acquisition_rules.acq_world: Purchase the unpurchased line maximising the belief-expected absolute LLR increment under the current blended two-class predictive: E[ |log p(a|h*) - log p(a|h_r)| ] with the expectation over the belief-mixture predictive of a (belief from the current LLR, K = 7 quadrature per component as in v5). This is the dual-core arm: the virtual cell steers evidence acquisition; it never enters the e-statistic in the stat_marginal variant and it DOES enter the statistic in the stat_world variant (registered factorial).
acquisition_rules.acq_oracle_reading: Label-blind ceiling (v5b C3 discipline): sees the realised future readings, purchases the line maximising the realised absolute LLR increment. It cannot see the label and can be charged QC failures. It upper-bounds what ANY acquisition can achieve with this statistic and menu.

arms.factorial: stat_marginal x {acq_fixed, acq_random, acq_world} and stat_world x {acq_fixed, acq_random, acq_world}: marg_fixed, marg_random, marg_world, world_fixed, world_random, world_world
ceiling: oracle_reading (stat_marginal increments, realised; and a world-increment sensitivity if cheap)
controls: world_world_shuffled: label-breaking; episode readings are another held-out compound's readings (permuted within fold, v5 mechanism); measures empirical Type-I behaviour under model mismatch
world_world_masked: the compound's purchased readings replaced by another held-out compound's readings at the same positions (v5 mechanism); compound-specificity control
marg_nowin_world: stat_marginal without winsorization under acq_world; the exact-martingale sensitivity arm
arms.stopping_comparator: On the SAME world_world trajectories, the v2-v5 calibrated-tau margin stopping rule (split-half calibration on the training fold, TAU_GRID5, selection rule decided >= 20 and point wrong rate <= 0.05) is evaluated and reported as arm world_world_taucal: the calibration-dependent comparator that quantifies what the e-threshold buys (no calibration episodes, no threshold-transfer assumption) or costs.

metrics: coverage (fraction of episodes decided either way)
conditional wrong rate among decided episodes, pooled and per fold, with Clopper-Pearson one-sided 95 percent UCB (primary validity number)
shuffled decide-true rate (empirical Type-I under label-breaking)
masked minus realistic coverage and correct gaps (compound specificity)
unit-cluster bootstrap intervals (10 000 draws, v1 mechanism) on all primary contrasts

gate_v6.G1_validity: world_world pooled conditional wrong rate <= 0.05 with CP one-sided UCB95 <= 0.10 AND world_world_shuffled decide-true rate <= 0.10. (Empirical e-process behaviour: the statistic the acquisition cannot game holds up on real data.)
gate_v6.G2_dual_core_value: world_world coverage > marg_random coverage (bootstrap interval excludes 0) AND world_world measurements per decided episode <= marg_fixed (the virtual cell plus acquisition reduces information cost below the strong deterministic baseline without losing validity)
gate_v6.G3_calibration_free: world_world at the fixed e-threshold has coverage >= world_world_taucal coverage with conditional wrong no worse (the calibration-free threshold does not lose power against the calibrated comparator)
gate_v6.interpretation: G1 is the scientific gate: if the e-process misbehaves on real data (Type-I inflation beyond the registered bounds), the reformulation fails regardless of power. G2 is the dual-core gate. G3 is the decision-mechanism gate. All three failing or G1 failing retires the e-process direction on this task and reopens the register.

conditional_unlock_llm_phase_B.trigger: runs if and only if G1 passes
conditional_unlock_llm_phase_B.design: llm_acq arm (DeepSeek via .env, reasoning model, completion budget >= 4000 tokens per call, seeded where the API allows, every prompt/response logged): at each step the LLM receives the episode state (two candidate class descriptors, per-line template summaries, purchased readings so far, current LLR, budget left) and returns the next line to purchase or STOP. Two information variants: llm_names (real class names; semantic-prior value, BioDiscoveryAgent-style, arXiv:2405.17631) and llm_blinded (classes renamed class_A/class_B; isolates the decision-policy value). Subsample: the first 60 SHA-ordered decided-or-abstained episodes of fold 0; <= 12 purchases per episode; hard spend cap USD 5; the same e-threshold and budget. Comparator: world_world on identical episodes (equally informed deterministic arm for llm_blinded).
conditional_unlock_llm_phase_B.registered_reading: llm_blinded vs world_world measures LLM-specific acquisition value with equal information; llm_names vs llm_blinded measures the semantic-prior channel. Invalid-action rate and provider cost are reported per Innovation.md's LLM-claim requirements.

efficiency_registration: The full non-LLM run is registered to complete in under 15 CPU-minutes in the maestro env (2-class statistic; world posterior rank <= 16 over <= 443 pool lines; ~490 episodes x 9 arms). Runtime is measured and reported; any arm exceeding the estimate by 3x is diagnosed, not silently accepted.
honesty_contract_additions: exact martingale validity is NOT claimed; validity is an empirical measurement with stated UCB discipline
